K02 is shown when a concept shows a member judging that the room has too few hands, or too little room, for a work it wants: doubt about numbers, a canvas judged too full, a work judged absent or outclassed (by a larger group, a script or bots), or a call to give up because the work cannot be held; one member saying there are not enough people is the lower range.
